portfolio_logic: Two independent causal scenarios share one global arbiter. No score changes risk. If simultaneous, funding reset has priority because its event time is externally fixed; otherwise the highest structural score is selected.

scenario_a.name: CAUSAL_METAORDER_PULLBACK_REACCELERATION
scenario_a.source: The previously locked candidate-02 v5 specification, unchanged.

scenario_b.name: FUNDING_SETTLEMENT_INVENTORY_RESET
scenario_b.market_logic: Before a scheduled perpetual funding settlement, price, open interest and the funding-paying side expand in the same direction. After settlement, a sweep of the previously observed 30-minute external boundary followed by a close back inside identifies inventory release rather than continuing price discovery.

execution.entry: next one-minute open after a completed confirmation bar
execution.stop_gap_policy: worse of stop or one-minute open
execution.quantity_rule: current NAV times 0.03 divided by expected per-unit stop loss including entry and stop costs and funding allowance
